source: Omron, MX2 User's Manual (I570), Appendix B, ModBus Data Listing

sources.title: 3G3MX2 Series Inverter User's Manual
sources.note: Appendix B-4, ModBus Coil List and ModBus Holding Registers

notes: Registers are numbered as in the manual. The manual states that the address on the wire is one less than the register number (register 0012h is sent as 0011h), so address_base is 1.
Functions: 0x01 and 0x05 coils, 0x03 read, 0x06 and 0x10 write, 0x17 read/write. The coils are the run, direction, trip, input terminal and status bits of section B-4-1.

Values that the manual lists as high and low registers are one 32-bit value, high register first (big word order). Network values are integers: the scale gives the resolution column of the manual (for example 0.01 Hz for frequencies).

The manual gives the parameter code of the inverter keypad (F001, A001, b001, C001, H001, P001) for each register; it is repeated at the start of each description. Enumerated values are listed in the descriptions rather than as tables.
Register 0900h writes to the EEPROM (0 recalculates the motor constants, 1 saves all data). Setting 0902h (EEPROM write mode) is referred to once when a 0x06 write is run.

The trip factors in registers 0012h to 0043h are the codes of the manual's list of inverter trip factors (1 over-current at constant speed, 5 overload protection, 7 overvoltage, 9 undervoltage, 12 external trip, 41 Modbus communication error and so on).

Serial defaults: 9600 baud (C071 = 05), station 1 (C072), no parity (C074 = 00), 1 stop bit (C075 = 01), 8 data bits. Baud rates 2400 to 115200 are selectable. Run and frequency commands over Modbus need A002 = 03 and A001 = 03.
Written from an automatic read of the manual's register tables; names that the manual wraps over two lines were joined, and ranges that include negative values are typed as signed.
